info.name: Amazon CloudWatch Create or update a metric alarm

params.name: AlarmName
params.description: The name for the alarm

params.name: AlarmDescription
params.description: A description for the alarm

params.name: Namespace
params.description: The namespace for the metric associated with the alarm

params.name: MetricName
params.description: The name for the metric associated with the alarm

params.name: Statistic
params.description: The statistic for the metric associated with the alarm

params.name: Period
params.description: The length in seconds of the evaluation period

params.name: EvaluationPeriods
params.description: The number of periods over which data is compared to the threshold

params.name: Threshold
params.description: The value to compare with the specified statistic

params.name: ComparisonOperator
params.description: The arithmetic operation to use when comparing the statistic and threshold

params.name: ActionsEnabled
params.description: Whether actions should be executed during alarm state changes

params.name: AlarmActions.member.1
params.description: The ARN of the action to execute when the alarm transitions to ALARM state

params.name: OKActions.member.1
params.description: The ARN of the action to execute when the alarm transitions to OK state

params.name: InsufficientDataActions.member.1
params.description: The ARN of the action to execute when the alarm transitions to INSUFFICIENT_DATA state

params.name: Dimensions.member.1.Name
params.description: The name of the dimension

params.name: Dimensions.member.1.Value
params.description: The value of the dimension

params.name: TreatMissingData
params.description: How to treat missing data when evaluating the alarm

items.docs: Creates or updates an alarm and associates it with the specified metric, metric math expression, anomaly detection model, or Metrics Insights query. When the alarm state changes, the action specified is performed.

params.name: AlarmNames.member.1
params.description: The name of the alarm to retrieve

params.name: AlarmNamePrefix
params.description: An alarm name prefix to filter by

params.name: StateValue
params.description: Filter by alarm state

params.name: ActionPrefix
params.description: An action name prefix to filter by

params.name: MaxRecords
params.description: The maximum number of alarm descriptions to retrieve

params.name: NextToken
params.description: Token for the next page of results

items.docs: Retrieves the specified alarms. You can filter the results by specifying a prefix for the alarm name, the alarm state, or a prefix for any action.

params.name: AlarmNames.member.1
params.description: The name of the alarm to delete

params.name: AlarmNames.member.2
params.description: Additional alarm name to delete

params.name: AlarmNames.member.3
params.description: Additional alarm name to delete

items.docs: Deletes the specified alarms. You can delete up to 100 alarms in one operation. In the event of an error, no alarms are deleted.
